description: This file implements an AES encryption driver for the Lantiq platform, including hardware interaction, request queuing, and multiple cipher mode support (ECB, CBC, CTR, RFC3686). It registers cryptographic algorithms, manages a request queue, and interfaces with hardware registers for AES operations.

methods.name: lq_deu_aes_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware for AES encryption/decryption, configuring hardware registers, managing DMA, and handling encryption modes.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist segments needed for a total byte size.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Initializes scatterlist mappings for source and destination buffers.

methods.name: lq_sg_complete
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an AES container after processing.

methods.name: aes_container_cast
methods.description: Retrieves the container structure from an ablkcipher_request.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next packet or scatterlist segment for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Tasklet to trigger processing of the next queued request.

methods.name: aes_crypto_thread
methods.description: Thread handling queued crypto requests, managing hardware state and request processing.

methods.name: lq_aes_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of AES requests, handles request segmentation, and initiates hardware processing.

methods.name: aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the AES key in the context.

methods.name: aes_generic_setkey
methods.description: Wrapper for setting AES key.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the key and nonce for RFC3686 mode.

methods.name: aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts an ablkcipher request using queued hardware.

methods.name: aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an ablkcipher request using queued hardware.

methods.name: ecb_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts using ECB mode.

methods.name: ecb_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts using ECB mode.

methods.name: cbc_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts using CBC mode.

methods.name: cbc_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts using CBC mode.

methods.name: ctr_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts using CTR mode.

methods.name: ctr_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts using CTR mode.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts using RFC3686 mode with nonce handling.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts using RFC3686 mode with nonce handling.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_aes_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers AES algorithms with the kernel crypto API.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_aes
methods.description: Unregisters AES algorithms and cleans up resources.
